that began when he was nine. Thierry Henry joins as Director of Football, having worked behind the scenes on the brand's football strategy since late 2025.

On plans to launch its first football boots in 2027, then develop kits and eventually lifestyle products and trainers, people familiar with the plans told the FT. On describes the move as applying the same approach that built CloudTec and LightSpray in running to a new sport, working with a selective group of elite players to rethink product for football. It is betting its LightSpray technology, which uses robots to spray a continuous filament forming a shoe's upper, can win share in a market Nike, Adidas and Puma dominate.

Nike and Adidas each supplied boots for more than 40% of players at this summer's World Cup, with Puma around 10%, according to Futbol Emotion. Under Armour never established a lasting presence and New Balance remains small. Skechers entered in 2023 with Harry Kane.

title: On Signs Mbappe, Ending His Two Decades With Nike
